paragraphs: I'm a full stack developer in Addis Ababa and a Computer Science graduate of Bahir Dar University (2026). Since September 2026 I've worked as a Junior Full Stack Developer at Mereb Technologies.

I focus on designing and developing scalable web applications and robust backend architectures. I enjoy working across the entire stack—building responsive user interfaces, designing efficient APIs and databases, ensuring high security standards, and streamlining CI/CD workflows.

Outside work I build products for real problems: a procurement platform for Ethiopian suppliers, a real-time collaborative workspace, an online store, and spending controls for AI agents on Solana. One day I want to launch my own startup.
